newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian net foreign debt A$199.902 bln in Q1.
newsitem.headline: Australian net foreign debt A$199.902 bln in Q1.

text.p: Australia's net foreign debt rose to A$199.902 billion in the March quarter from A$199.197 billion in the December quarter (revised from A$202.367 billion), the Australian Bureau of Statistics said on Wednesday.
This compared with net debt of A$186.331 billion a year earlier.
Gross foreign debt rose to A$250.533 billion from A$245.907 billion in the December quarter (revised from A$248.453 billion) compared with A$231.064 billion a year earlier, the bureau said.
Net Foreign Debt Mar Qtr 97 Dec Qtr 96 Mar Qtr 96
The Bureau said the ratio of net foreign debt to GDP for the year to the end of the March quarter was 39.4 percent, up from a revised 39.7 percent at the end of the December quarter.
The previous December quarter figure was 40.3 percent.
